_: Who can be in a short. brief: the voice, described, for the voice designer (npm run short -- --design <id>). manner: how they always talk (voice tags added to every line). fx: what's done to the voice after (see FX in lib/media.mjs). voiceOf: share another character's voice. look: what they are, for the video model. lipsync: false for anyone without a mouth to sync. voice: an ElevenLabs stock voice, only used with voice.provider 'elevenlabs' in kit.json. image: a picture to use instead of the game's (or drop one in shorts/characters/<id>.png).

pimples.name: Brayden
pimples.brief: A twitchy, greasy young man's voice that cracks between octaves mid-word, squeaky and wet, lips smacking, little pained hisses as if every word squeezes a pimple. Uncomfortable to listen to.
pimples.look: a bald pale head on a long neck, its face covered in red pimples, bloodshot eyes

stubble.name: Drak
stubble.brief: A sandpaper-rough, gravel-throated man who hasn't slept or shaved in a week, growling every word through clenched teeth, scratchy breaths, constantly irritated and ready to snap.
stubble.look: a bald man's head with pointed ears, a heavy stubble shadow and tired red-rimmed eyes

droopy.name: Orville
droopy.brief: An extremely slow, sagging, monotone old voice whose pitch droops at the end of every phrase, long exhausted sighs, words slurring and dripping downward like melting wax, as if falling asleep mid-word.
droopy.look: a long sagging old man's head with heavy drooping eyelids and jowls

sweats.name: Dennis
sweats.brief: A breathless, clammy, panicking voice, panting and gulping between words, talking too fast then stalling, wet nervous swallows, always on the edge of hyperventilating.
sweats.look: a clammy bald head dripping blue sweat, with worried eyes

weeper.name: Pud
weeper.brief: A trembling, perpetually sobbing voice, blubbering and sniffling through every word, high and wavering, clogged with snot, pitiful and wet, hiccuping mid-sentence.
weeper.look: a lopsided swollen head with one huge bloodshot eye, weeping blue tears

screamer.name: Teddy
screamer.brief: A shrill, hoarse, ear-splitting voice that cannot stop screaming, raw and shredded from yelling, words coming out as shrieks and ragged gasps. Jarring and abrasive.
screamer.look: a skull-like head with huge round staring eyes and a wide gaping mouth of rotten teeth

roast.name: Glorp
roast.brief: A deep, bubbling, gurgling voice like something speaking up through hot fat, wet crackles and sizzles between words, slow and greasy, barely human.
roast.look: a lumpy pink roasted blob of flesh lying in a puddle of its own juices

toad.name: Gub
toad.brief: A croaking, guttural, phlegmy voice, deep and lazy, burping between words, wet slurping sounds, smug and disgusting.
toad.look: a fat green toad creature with bulging orange eyes, drooling blue slime

shiv.name: Shiv
shiv.brief: A thin, wheedling, nasal voice, oily and too smooth then suddenly whiny, hissing every S, sniffing constantly through a very long nose.
shiv.look: a skinny wrinkled creature with a long fleshy nose and bulging eyes
shiv.mouthStill: Extreme macro close-up of this exact creature's face, framed tightly on its mouth and the long fleshy trunk that grows out of it, filling the whole picture from edge to edge: the same skin, teeth, colours and photoreal 3D render style, glistening and wet, soft dramatic light, no background visible.
shiv.mouthClip: Extreme macro close-up of a grotesque creature's face, framed tightly on its mouth and the long fleshy trunk growing out of it: the trunk twitches and quivers, glistening and dripping, and the mouth works slowly around it with small sticky wet sounds. The camera holds perfectly still. Grotesque, glossy 3D creature render. Quiet, very close-microphone mouth sounds only: no music, no voice, no words.

conehead.name: Doolie
conehead.brief: A deranged, high, nasal, wet voice belonging to a grinning cone-headed creature. Sing-song and far too cheerful, spit bubbling on every S, sudden manic giggles, voice cracking and wobbling, unsettling pauses in the wrong places. Abrasive and off-putting.
conehead.look: a cone-shaped head with huge bulging eyes and a wide manic grin

redeye.name: Nerm
redeye.brief: A dry, cracked, sleep-deprived whisper, raspy and flat and eerily calm, as if staring without blinking, with long unnerving pauses and a twitch catching in the throat.
redeye.look: a bald head with huge yellow eyes and a bleeding cut across its face

tendrils.name: Marla
tendrils.brief: A soft, airy, slithering voice that seems to come from several places at once, breathy and whispery, wet tongue clicks between words, alien and unsettling.
tendrils.look: a pink fleshy head with long hair-like tendrils streaming off it

melter.name: Duane
melter.brief: A thick, sludgy, dripping voice whose words slide and melt into each other, syrupy and wet, bubbling now and then, sad and disgusting.
melter.look: a melting head with one big eye, its face sliding and dripping

bricks.name: Doug
bricks.brief: A heavy, blocky, stiff voice, punchy and staccato like bricks being dropped one by one, grit and dust in the throat, proud and a bit dim.
bricks.look: a square head made of cracked fleshy bricks, with a toothy grin

bigeye.name: Greg
bigeye.brief: A paranoid, intense, too-loud old man who sees everything, gravelly and strained, hissing through yellow teeth, every sentence an accusation, eye twitching in his voice.
bigeye.look: a wrinkled bald head with one enormous bulging eye and gritted yellow teeth

mirror.name: Pim
mirror.brief: An uncanny, warped voice that sounds slightly wrong, too smooth and too close, like it is copying your voice and getting it almost right. Hypnotic and creepy.
mirror.look: a lumpy pale head with misplaced eyes and a gaping toothy mouth

leprechaun.name: Fergal
leprechaun.brief: A cackling, wheezing, gleefully nasty old Irish voice, phlegmy laughter bubbling under every word, spitting consonants, greedy and mischievous.
leprechaun.look: a grinning ginger-bearded man's head in a green cap

snoot.name: Hork
snoot.brief: A deeply nasal, honking, congested voice, every word blown out through a long dripping nose, snorting and sniffing, slow and pretentious.
snoot.look: a bald head with an exposed brain, pointed ears and a long dripping trunk of a nose

fairy.name: Mabel
fairy.brief: A tiny, high, buzzing voice like an insect pretending to be sweet, sugary on top with a nasty raspy edge underneath, giggling at the wrong moments.
fairy.look: a tiny gross fairy with insect wings and an antenna like a fishing rod, sitting on a mushroom

antenna.name: Zib
antenna.brief: A crackling, glitching alien voice, flat and curious, consonants buzzing and clicking, words cutting in and out like a bad signal.
antenna.look: a skinny red-skinned creature with one antenna, wearing a loincloth

spoon-nana.name: Spoon Nana
spoon-nana.brief: A rasping, wheezing, crotchety old grandmother, a forty-a-day smoker's rattle in her chest, gumming her words with no teeth, scolding and sour.
spoon-nana.look: a fat grumpy grandmother creature in a floral dress

bat-rat.name: Skitch
bat-rat.brief: A squeaky, chittering, hissing voice, high and fast, words breaking into squeaks and clicks, twitchy and feral.
bat-rat.look: a bat-eared, rat-faced creature with big orange eyes

head-bloom.name: The Aunties
head-bloom.brief: A choir of tiny overlapping whispers, dry and rattling like bones in a jar, ancient and hollow, deeply unsettling.
head-bloom.look: a cluster of tiny skulls blooming on a spiny stalk, with moth wings

snoot-2.name: Uncle Hork
snoot-2.look: a bald head with an exposed brain, one huge bulging eye and a long dripping trunk of a nose

snoot-3.name: Cousin Hork
snoot-3.look: a bald head with an exposed brain, gauged earlobes and a long dripping nose
